crossRefs.note: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold…
As Yahweh’s ark came into David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window, and saw king David…

parallels.note: “Through the window she looked out, and cried: Sisera’s mother looked through the lattice. ‘Why is his chariot so long…

translations.web: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
translations.bsb: For at the window of my house I looked through the lattice.
translations.kjv: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
translations.asv: For at the window of my house I looked forth through my lattice;
